sections.h2: 1. Compare {code} with the Black Friday codes
parts: When we checked on November 25, 2026, parfaitlingerie.com showed two Black Friday codes in its banner: $25 off a $150 purchase (BFCM25) and $50 off a $200 purchase (BFCM50). Shopify checkouts usually take one discount code per order, so pick the one that saves most for your cart:

parts: A single Seamless Hipster Panty is $16. The 3 pack is $38 and the 6 pack $49, which is about $8.17 a pair, or about $6.94 with {code}. The Seamless Mid-Waist Brief is $18 alone, $44 for 3 and $52 for 6.

Some colors are marked down 30% on the site: when we checked, the Charlotte Padded Longline Bra in Petal Pink Dot, the Shea Unlined Plunge Bra in Silver and the Mia Lace Bralette in Bare were $39.20 instead of $56. Items marked Final Sale can't be returned or exchanged, so check the size chart before buying them.

US shipping is a flat $7.99 for 3 to 4 business days, or $14.99 for 2-day expedited, and the site banner offers free shipping on orders of $100 or more. Two bras usually get you there: the Elise and the Elissa come to $124, or $105.40 with {code}. Check that the total after the code still reaches $100.

Orders are processed within 1 to 2 business days. Parfait ships to the US (Hawaii and Alaska included, from $12.99), Canada, the UK and the EU; outside the US the cost depends on the order and destination, and import duties aren't refunded.

Unworn, unwashed items can be returned within 30 days of the order date, or 60 days if you add REDO coverage at checkout, through the returns portal on its site. US return labels are free, but the original shipping isn't refunded. Canadian returns cost CAD $14.95, and UK and EU buyers pay the return postage. Final Sale items can't be returned, and a free gift that came with the order must go back too. Our [Parfait review](saving-tips-parfait-review.html) sums up the ratings and the complaints.
